# _Templates shelf

Hold reusable blank knowledge-note structure.

## Inputs

[Note template](note.md).

## Process

Copy note.md to the relevant topic shelf; replace placeholders and select type/status from [the bundle contract](../CONTEXT.md). Use actual sources and relative Markdown links.

## Outputs

A filled note linked from its shelf contract; template remains blank.

## Human check

Check that the new note has one owner, concrete sources, and no unresolved placeholders.
